title: Default Notice
description:
default-notice/v2 — the document a default-notice event carries. Asserted by the non-defaulting side's role (whichever of pledger/receiver the account policy names as the asserter of its container's 'default' condition — see the policy templates) to activate the unilateral seizure authorization on the OTHER side's container, independent of whether the agreement itself is later interrupted by closeout-default. Sticky in the event log until a matching default-revocation from the same role.

The document is informational: the definition's guard asks only who is emitting and when.

conditionName.description: The account policy condition this notice activates — 'default' for every container the facade provisions today.

reason.description: What triggered the assertion, e.g. a missed margin call. Free text for the audit trail.
